scientific_conclusion: The Stage-126 band-level tangential-side reversal resolves into one wall-normal zero crossing on each opposite wall. The 28-depth asymmetry profiles are highly coherent across walls (cosine 0.9831956762946098; Pearson 0.9928442700731575), their dominant-side labels agree at 27/28 depths, and the two interpolated crossings at 14.71694048265934 and 15.552724000693987 cells differ by only 0.8357835180346473 cells, within the fixed two-cell guard. This establishes a bilateral narrow transition zone rather than a one-wall or broad-band averaging artifact. It does not yet establish the physical origin of the switch because the parent dominant radial node and net sign also change across the mid-to-inner band boundary. A fixed radial-node continuity audit is therefore justified. No limiter causality, MUSCL stability, endpoint convergence, q_av improvement, benchmark accuracy, or validation is claimed.
